title: Nvidia Board Reportedly Probes Spying Case Targeting Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia&\#x27;s board is reportedly investigating an intelligence operation that targeted CEO Jensen Huang, not investigating Huang himself, according to the submitted report and commenters. One commenter cited a Bloomberg headline saying the board would probe a spying case after Huang admitted infidelity. The supplied source page contained no article text, so the board statement&\#x27;s wording and the investigation&\#x27;s scope could not be independently verified here.
